Tamarisk Quay — production code list, 14 October 2026

10. OUTCOME CODE TABLE. These are the only allowed combinations; omit reason entirely for rows with none:
tamarisk_arranged: (no reason)
tamarisk_settled: (no reason)
tamarisk_transferred: tamarisk_restructure | tamarisk_person | tamarisk_care
tamarisk_no_deal: tamarisk_refused | tamarisk_distress | tamarisk_disputed | tamarisk_service_error
tamarisk_unverified: tamarisk_failed | tamarisk_declined
tamarisk_unreached: tamarisk_callback | tamarisk_no_callback | tamarisk_wrong_number | tamarisk_deceased | tamarisk_unclear

Note reasons only: tamarisk_refused, tamarisk_distress, tamarisk_disputed, tamarisk_settled, tamarisk_service_error.
Transfer queues: tamarisk_restructure (restructuring), tamarisk_desk (human), tamarisk_care (hardship).
